[Highlight start] **Sulfites in wine are unlikely to cause headaches for most people** [Highlight end] **.** While they are a common scapegoat, scientific evidence largely points to other factors—such as alcohol itself, dehydration, and compounds found in grapes—rather than sulfites.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1_cxdvxNZ9_28zOo4McSwyVZR4pyCOedtOkrG1EPx-Oc9oHtvAlxOa7xnid-GHHbgjCygzDUx8INFu5_Ey2ghpGzoB-gdIBj4U0mZ43LM8-sGFMV1MhRr4DCUcGcoU64B8g-QI4YCl5sNrCSKkl75dgFD9k5yYd0fokBXbJDlSNn0eai6--DwpEih24)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXd7oHe1ClkSnsaiWKfofXCas0KSSCU2jmEVwhTzmGzFo4IEKzgSw3u3eovN59MyFOg8cXQO7aZEe3zEQE7r_7QM7hiRtezHd-8sFoCfiVqZkn4362N_pAbKt6S0p7yGM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXSMcxw9r9yxXHPUNLmxMz7W0ogaaCgTPi0un5LmzIrre3Y8HEbg5565GcajQFgF4sd-OMd7DO9SH8tXo2khQKnB0PeYRgng-4w0ZiLx_mzYocpJRyAsP-GwFCzj2vWKHbtg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF136vpXhWtNvoub_5-maiUyiKNE_rRdDCrnMzanPOZRu3hYt34kYh_UEoQ26XYeSDdzjHNe5-MERBou0NOB_jc1dVq6dpCsDc1K1mBY5bHO9dLBRh38z5ZwDN9ABNi8apE6xThr48s4UpIJZMfvig2aj-ZeyMcwWE3j_K3KU_MCguhT9WVSfyV5HzE7_3it5GvB74_9lZl-aaAA)

### Why Sulfites Are Unlikely the Culprit

- **Weak scientific link:** Most medical experts and researchers note there is little strong evidence directly linking sulfites to headaches.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF136vpXhWtNvoub_5-maiUyiKNE_rRdDCrnMzanPOZRu3hYt34kYh_UEoQ26XYeSDdzjHNe5-MERBou0NOB_jc1dVq6dpCsDc1K1mBY5bHO9dLBRh38z5ZwDN9ABNi8apE6xThr48s4UpIJZMfvig2aj-ZeyMcwWE3j_K3KU_MCguhT9WVSfyV5HzE7_3it5GvB74_9lZl-aaAA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1_cxdvxNZ9_28zOo4McSwyVZR4pyCOedtOkrG1EPx-Oc9oHtvAlxOa7xnid-GHHbgjCygzDUx8INFu5_Ey2ghpGzoB-gdIBj4U0mZ43LM8-sGFMV1MhRr4DCUcGcoU64B8g-QI4YCl5sNrCSKkl75dgFD9k5yYd0fokBXbJDlSNn0eai6--DwpEih24)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF15CkxIkOzlFuKiK5_zjcZ_fBW6POytJG8_w_KCVonaC4GgBCtz_oePL9a-mY3ttoekH9f6HfXmxDN_xVvmeY-iZIxak4G8sn6oRfnFc2uxswWhrsEl-POGzL5mzSjpppt4SgGwUx6pVcJ_GZpgZkGJ2ZA6ZnpwyHQyL9Zg)
- **True sulfite sensitivity looks different:** Fewer than 1% of people have a true sulfite sensitivity or allergy. When it occurs, it typically causes respiratory issues (like asthma flare-ups or wheezing) or skin reactions (like hives), rather than headaches.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF1ytrZlDCD0xkKpzpcLPcVSFhkMgghOT7oudSTFcSTidB6ejzI9nu7TL-wyV-ffGjA2c_L4FvbVXOBw1DQ_D71BbEPz6fLW0uVhGSzV68AVhdwv_PeObZQH55rYZVKUziqllmKw6hxcPCZBmEbjcHSESFKZpBI3McEgqGxQt8gZ8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXd7oHe1ClkSnsaiWKfofXCas0KSSCU2jmEVwhTzmGzFo4IEKzgSw3u3eovN59MyFOg8cXQO7aZEe3zEQE7r_7QM7hiRtezHd-8sFoCfiVqZkn4362N_pAbKt6S0p7yGM)
- **Other foods have more:** A typical glass of wine contains roughly 10 to 20 mg of sulfites, whereas foods like dried apricots contain much higher amounts without triggering headaches for most people. Your body also naturally produces hundreds of milligrams of sulfites daily.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF15CkxIkOzlFuKiK5_zjcZ_fBW6POytJG8_w_KCVonaC4GgBCtz_oePL9a-mY3ttoekH9f6HfXmxDN_xVvmeY-iZIxak4G8sn6oRfnFc2uxswWhrsEl-POGzL5mzSjpppt4SgGwUx6pVcJ_GZpgZkGJ2ZA6ZnpwyHQyL9Zg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1_cxdvxNZ9_28zOo4McSwyVZR4pyCOedtOkrG1EPx-Oc9oHtvAlxOa7xnid-GHHbgjCygzDUx8INFu5_Ey2ghpGzoB-gdIBj4U0mZ43LM8-sGFMV1MhRr4DCUcGcoU64B8g-QI4YCl5sNrCSKkl75dgFD9k5yYd0fokBXbJDlSNn0eai6--DwpEih24)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX0ZKSulYSP-xDGHporC69Y-6ptgTQ5ML6uH7yJnYJOCy6nQEhV0bt34ZfJwRdZOYriydLqe_wBP7ojf7alYX4hSAYkUQqGDKsTFHIt7DLhYU7HcckDNN43g_WQiW9hwxGzg)
- **White vs. red wine:** White wines often contain comparable or higher sulfite levels than red wines, yet red wine is more frequently associated with wine headaches.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1_cxdvxNZ9_28zOo4McSwyVZR4pyCOedtOkrG1EPx-Oc9oHtvAlxOa7xnid-GHHbgjCygzDUx8INFu5_Ey2ghpGzoB-gdIBj4U0mZ43LM8-sGFMV1MhRr4DCUcGcoU64B8g-QI4YCl5sNrCSKkl75dgFD9k5yYd0fokBXbJDlSNn0eai6--DwpEih24)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF136vpXhWtNvoub_5-maiUyiKNE_rRdDCrnMzanPOZRu3hYt34kYh_UEoQ26XYeSDdzjHNe5-MERBou0NOB_jc1dVq6dpCsDc1K1mBY5bHO9dLBRh38z5ZwDN9ABNi8apE6xThr48s4UpIJZMfvig2aj-ZeyMcwWE3j_K3KU_MCguhT9WVSfyV5HzE7_3it5GvB74_9lZl-aaAA)

As [UC Davis](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1_cxdvxNZ9_28zOo4McSwyVZR4pyCOedtOkrG1EPx-Oc9oHtvAlxOa7xnid-GHHbgjCygzDUx8INFu5_Ey2ghpGzoB-gdIBj4U0mZ43LM8-sGFMV1MhRr4DCUcGcoU64B8g-QI4YCl5sNrCSKkl75dgFD9k5yYd0fokBXbJDlSNn0eai6--DwpEih24) notes, sulfites became a common target after U.S. labeling rules took effect, even though the amounts in a glass of wine are small and rarely overwhelm the body's normal processing.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1_cxdvxNZ9_28zOo4McSwyVZR4pyCOedtOkrG1EPx-Oc9oHtvAlxOa7xnid-GHHbgjCygzDUx8INFu5_Ey2ghpGzoB-gdIBj4U0mZ43LM8-sGFMV1MhRr4DCUcGcoU64B8g-QI4YCl5sNrCSKkl75dgFD9k5yYd0fokBXbJDlSNn0eai6--DwpEih24)

### More Likely Causes of Wine Headaches

- **Alcohol and dehydration:** Alcohol dilates blood vessels and acts as a diuretic, contributing to dehydration and headaches.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXd7oHe1ClkSnsaiWKfofXCas0KSSCU2jmEVwhTzmGzFo4IEKzgSw3u3eovN59MyFOg8cXQO7aZEe3zEQE7r_7QM7hiRtezHd-8sFoCfiVqZkn4362N_pAbKt6S0p7yGM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF136vpXhWtNvoub_5-maiUyiKNE_rRdDCrnMzanPOZRu3hYt34kYh_UEoQ26XYeSDdzjHNe5-MERBou0NOB_jc1dVq6dpCsDc1K1mBY5bHO9dLBRh38z5ZwDN9ABNi8apE6xThr48s4UpIJZMfvig2aj-ZeyMcwWE3j_K3KU_MCguhT9WVSfyV5HzE7_3it5GvB74_9lZl-aaAA)
- **Grape and fermentation compounds:** Researchers and clinicians often look at compounds like tannins, histamines, tyramine, and flavonoids/quercetin (especially in red wine). [Harvard Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF136vpXhWtNvoub_5-maiUyiKNE_rRdDCrnMzanPOZRu3hYt34kYh_UEoQ26XYeSDdzjHNe5-MERBou0NOB_jc1dVq6dpCsDc1K1mBY5bHO9dLBRh38z5ZwDN9ABNi8apE6xThr48s4UpIJZMfvig2aj-ZeyMcwWE3j_K3KU_MCguhT9WVSfyV5HzE7_3it5GvB74_9lZl-aaAA) highlights that while no single theory is proven, factors like tannins, histamines, alcohol's effect on blood vessels, and drinking without food or water can all play a role.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXSJzK7l64zx9zZJ7ivGjiznX5vUJHuDO7x4DV0wvhm3e-l-NJqMqP4OTeAl80fgV14AGOnvhdrDQL6Sl15JILVK3lxwqXQAeh92LN3GAx-QaT5FScvZFwVLVfg5UB_AFcZMklQJX2EakGLLSS5SbtNOhB8VB-kvLN9w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF136vpXhWtNvoub_5-maiUyiKNE_rRdDCrnMzanPOZRu3hYt34kYh_UEoQ26XYeSDdzjHNe5-MERBou0NOB_jc1dVq6dpCsDc1K1mBY5bHO9dLBRh38z5ZwDN9ABNi8apE6xThr48s4UpIJZMfvig2aj-ZeyMcwWE3j_K3KU_MCguhT9WVSfyV5HzE7_3it5GvB74_9lZl-aaAA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXG4Gv2AwCkLRc58FokuNAxWSAY4wyGz2OlZxdsoFIZ8RDAiIOZ3U8YUpJfXNuI_Awfothb9eZnxJy44bQ-ijbuRo_gTvxqj7tZ-WLhwRtX7imE-QI4voFgGquaH7wXUxjwYrvk356)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXQ4fBM9H7fwBFZaUcXdill_xpmin_Gr5gaKSSDbWtyp7GAPxrZKUqXlPqxRUO5hh8gvyPZXESH0l-7WUA4uCHqb9jVqin97FrUfvhraHk7vIrho3sgdCO_BYQ8nPy6Mah4DXoYLI7Aw)
- **Different perspectives:** On a [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF107KIn_SWPuDu_r7wnqWa1AzQ0TRhHFOKCXsVmbg1WvFL-qJncpjhdscdshNmxr4KKwV-o8V_F2iVZpt-rqqfCm6pYsigdGc3Yqd9BeMC1Sth3EnFc-k6IpWmtXT1T-sNvPqBNEscAU9Z6SUaKkRTvRcmn0Z7QhIjyrNvh9okEAuPcP0w3i0cI1KrbtK_2dkwMiFdOGXuQZYNjKwvQ) thread, opinions are mixed on what drives wine headaches—some point to biogenic amines like histamine (particularly in bold reds or certain fermented wines), while others emphasize alcohol, dehydration, or other compounds.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF107KIn_SWPuDu_r7wnqWa1AzQ0TRhHFOKCXsVmbg1WvFL-qJncpjhdscdshNmxr4KKwV-o8V_F2iVZpt-rqqfCm6pYsigdGc3Yqd9BeMC1Sth3EnFc-k6IpWmtXT1T-sNvPqBNEscAU9Z6SUaKkRTvRcmn0Z7QhIjyrNvh9okEAuPcP0w3i0cI1KrbtK_2dkwMiFdOGXuQZYNjKwvQ)

Are you trying to figure out **what triggers headaches** after drinking wine, or looking for **ways to prevent them** ? Sharing whether they happen mostly with **red or white wine** —or alongside **other symptoms** —can help narrow down what to look into.

items.text: Alcohol and dehydration: Alcohol dilates blood vessels and acts as a diuretic, contributing to dehydration and headaches. Grape and fermentation compounds: Researchers and clinicians often look at compounds like tannins, histamines, tyramine, and flavonoids/quercetin (especially in red wine). Harvard Health highlights that while no single theory is proven, factors like tannins, histamines, alcohol's effect on blood vessels, and drinking without food or water can all play a role. Different perspectives: On a Reddit thread, opinions are mixed on what drives wine headaches—some point to biogenic amines like histamine (particularly in bold reds or certain fermented wines), while others emphasize alcohol, dehydration, or other compounds.
